3. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

# ── Color Palette (editorial, muted, publication-ready) ──
COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C44E52',
    'South Asia':         '#DD8452',
    'Europe':             '#4C72B0',
    'North America':      '#55A868',
}
REGION_ORDER = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
REGION_SHORT = ['Sub-Saharan\nAfrica', 'South\nAsia', 'Europe', 'North\nAmerica']

BG_COLOR = '#FAFAFA'
GRID_COLOR = '#E0E0E0'
TEXT_COLOR = '#2B2B2B'
SUBTLE_TEXT = '#666666'
ANNOTATION_COLOR = '#B0B0B0'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica'],
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': SUBTLE_TEXT,
    'ytick.color': SUBTLE_TEXT,
    'axes.edgecolor': '#CCCCCC',
    'axes.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FFFFFF',
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.color': GRID_COLOR,
    'grid.linewidth': 0.5,
    'grid.alpha': 0.7,
})

# ── Data ──
# Income quintile data
income_quintiles = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
income_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': [6, 14, 25, 42, 68],
    'South Asia':         [12, 24, 39, 56, 78],
    'Europe':             [72, 82, 89, 94, 97],
    'North America':      [75, 85, 92, 96, 99],
}

# Age group data
age_groups = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']
age_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': [38, 32, 26, 18, 11, 5],
    'South Asia':         [55, 48, 38, 27, 16, 8],
    'Europe':             [98, 96, 93, 88, 79, 58],
    'North America':      [99, 97, 95, 91, 84, 65],
}

# Urban-Rural data
urban_rural = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': {'Urban': 42, 'Rural': 13},
    'South Asia':         {'Urban': 58, 'Rural': 22},
    'Europe':             {'Urban': 92, 'Rural': 78},
    'North America':      {'Urban': 95, 'Rural': 80},
}

# Overall data
overall = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': {'penetration': 27, 'pop': 1210, 'users': 327},
    'South Asia':         {'penetration': 40, 'pop': 1980, 'users': 792},
    'Europe':             {'penetration': 89, 'pop': 750, 'users': 668},
    'North America':      {'penetration': 93, 'pop': 380, 'users': 353},
}

# ── Figure Layout ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 14))
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, hspace=0.35, wspace=0.28,
                       left=0.07, right=0.95, top=0.88, bottom=0.06)

# ── Suptitle ──
fig.suptitle('The Global Digital Divide: Internet Penetration Across Four Dimensions of Inequality',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, y=0.96)
fig.text(0.5, 0.925,
         'Internet penetration rates (%) by income, age, urban/rural setting, and region  ·  2023 estimates  ·  Source: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research',
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9.5, color=SUBTLE_TEXT)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel A: Income Quintile (Slope chart / line chart)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax1.set_title('A. Income Gradient', loc='left', pad=10)

for region in REGION_ORDER:
    vals = income_data[region]
    ax1.plot(range(5), vals, marker='o', markersize=6, linewidth=2.5,
             color=COLORS[region], label=region, zorder=3)

# Highlight the Q1–Q5 spread for developing regions
for region in ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia']:
    q1 = income_data[region][0]
    q5 = income_data[region][4]
    ax1.annotate('', xy=(4.15, q5), xytext=(4.15, q1),
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=COLORS[region], lw=1.5))
    ax1.text(4.35, (q1 + q5) / 2, f'{q5 - q1}pp\ngap',
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
             color=COLORS[region])

ax1.set_xticks(range(5))
ax1.set_xticklabels(income_quintiles, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)')
ax1.set_ylim(-2, 108)
ax1.set_xlim(-0.3, 5.1)
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#DDD')


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel B: Age Group (Line chart with youth-elder gap annotation)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.set_title('B. Age Divide', loc='left', pad=10)

for region in REGION_ORDER:
    vals = age_data[region]
    ax2.plot(range(6), vals, marker='s', markersize=5, linewidth=2.5,
             color=COLORS[region], label=region, zorder=3)

# Annotate youth vs elder gaps
for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    youth = age_data[region][0]
    elder = age_data[region][5]
    gap = youth - elder
    # Place gap annotation at the right end
    offset_x = 5.15
    ax2.text(offset_x, elder, f'−{gap}pp',
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',
             color=COLORS[region])

ax2.set_xticks(range(6))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_groups, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax2.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(-2, 108)
ax2.set_xlim(-0.3, 5.7)
ax2.legend(loc='lower left', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#DDD')


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel C: Urban vs Rural (Dumbbell / dot plot)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax3.set_title('C. Urban–Rural Gap', loc='left', pad=10)

y_pos = np.arange(len(REGION_ORDER))
for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    urban = urban_rural[region]['Urban']
    rural = urban_rural[region]['Rural']
    gap = urban - rural
    # Connecting line
    ax3.plot([rural, urban], [i, i], color=COLORS[region], linewidth=3, zorder=2)
    # Rural dot
    ax3.scatter(rural, i, color='white', edgecolor=COLORS[region], s=120,
                linewidth=2.5, zorder=4, label='Rural' if i == 0 else '')
    # Urban dot
    ax3.scatter(urban, i, color=COLORS[region], edgecolor=COLORS[region], s=120,
                linewidth=2.5, zorder=4, label='Urban' if i == 0 else '')
    # Gap label
    ax3.text((urban + rural) / 2, i + 0.28, f'{gap}pp gap',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
             color=COLORS[region])

ax3.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax3.set_yticklabels(REGION_SHORT, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)')
ax3.set_xlim(0, 105)
ax3.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.8)
ax3.invert_yaxis()
ax3.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#DDD',
           ncol=2, handletextpad=0.3, columnspacing=1)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel D: Regional Overview (Stacked horizontal bar with overall penetration)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax4.set_title('D. Regional Overview', loc='left', pad=10)

y_pos = np.arange(len(REGION_ORDER))
bar_h = 0.55

for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    pen = overall[region]['penetration']
    pop = overall[region]['pop']
    users = overall[region]['users']
    not_connected = pop - users

    # Full bar (penetration)
    ax4.barh(i, pen, height=bar_h, color=COLORS[region], zorder=3, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    # Not-connected portion (faded)
    ax4.barh(i, 100 - pen, height=bar_h, left=pen, color=COLORS[region],
             alpha=0.15, zorder=2, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

    # Penetration label inside bar
    ax4.text(pen / 2, i, f'{pen}%', ha='center', va='center',
             fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='white' if pen > 35 else TEXT_COLOR, zorder=5)

    # Population context to the right
    ax4.text(102, i, f'{users:,}M / {pop:,}M',
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color=SUBTLE_TEXT)

ax4.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax4.set_yticklabels(REGION_SHORT, fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)')
ax4.set_xlim(0, 125)
ax4.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.8)
ax4.invert_yaxis()

# Add "users / pop" header
ax4.text(102, -0.7, 'Users / Pop.', ha='left', va='center',
         fontsize=8, color=SUBTLE_TEXT, fontstyle='italic')


# ── Save ──
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='#FFFFFF', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved successfully.")
